test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 515 758 761 726 579 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number?2426
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 515 758 761 726 579 (Right)**

Highest number = 761

Second digit of the highest number = 6

Lowest number = 515 

Second digit of the lowest number = 1

Now, 6 + 1 = 7

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4**”.
